+def process_payment(amount, method, country, user, flags):
+    if amount is None:
+        return None
+    if amount < 0:
+        raise ValueError('neg')
+    if method == 'card':
+        if country == 'US':
+            if flags.get('vip'):
+                if amount > 1000:
+                    if user.get('verified'):
+                        return 'fast'
+                    else:
+                        return 'manual'
+                else:
+                    return 'ok'
+            else:
+                if amount > 500:
+                    return 'review'
+                return 'ok'
+        elif country == 'EU':
+            if amount > 200:
+                return 'sca'
+            return 'ok'
+        else:
+            return 'intl'
+    elif method == 'wallet':
+        if flags.get('blocked'):
+            return 'deny'
+        return 'wallet'
+    else:
+        return 'unknown'
